name: 21232-batchdecode-30ba3b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B, bf16, no quantization. Ungated and already in the local HF cache, 57 GB.
parallelism: TP=8 for attention and EP=8 for the 128 routed experts over the same eight ranks (16 physical experts per rank). DP=1, PP=1, DP attention off, no all-to-all MoE backend. ep-size 8 is forced: the server asserts `ep_size * moe_dp_size == tp_size`.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64. Warmup the first 25%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 2400 s safety cap, seed 42. ~3072 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~1024 prompt tokens in (stdev 128, clamped 512-1536) and ~512 tokens out (stdev 64, clamped 384-640). temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true via `spec.backend.extras.body`, so every request generates exactly the length it drew.
purpose: A mixture-of-experts chat assistant on eight GPUs, serving 64 concurrent users page-long prompts and half-page replies.
launch:
# The engine's command line: sglang at the commit named by setupcard.md `commit_id:`.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

tp-size: 8

# The server asserts `ep_size * moe_dp_size == tp_size` whenever ep_size > 1, and moe_dp_size is 1
# here, so on eight GPUs 8 is the only value that starts.
ep-size: 8

enable-eplb: true

# Counted in FORWARD PASSES, not seconds and not requests. The engine default is 1000.
eplb-rebalance-num-iterations: 400

disable-radix-cache: true

# Written out at their own default values for an 80 GB card, so the run does not depend on a
# device-memory probe.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.83
